note: Scam: owner abroad, no viewing, Western Union, keys by courier.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling for a renter about the apartment at 100 Harbour Street. Is it still available?

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: Hello. Yes, the unit is available. I am out of the country for work right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would someone be able to show it?

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: No, I can't show you the unit. Pay the first month by Western Union and I will courier the keys.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, I'll let my client know.

tool_facts.quote: I am out of the country for work right now
